name: Italian Poker
description: Poker all'italiana is a draw poker variant played with a short deck (32, 36 or 40 cards by player count). It has optional blind opening (buio), two betting rounds with a draw in between, and a non-standard hand ranking where flush beats full house and straight flushes have min-medium-max tie rules.

content.text: Poker all'italiana is a draw poker variant played with a short deck (32, 36 or 40 cards by player count). It has optional blind opening (buio), two betting rounds with a draw in between, and a non-standard hand ranking where flush beats full house and straight flushes have min-medium-max tie rules.
Italian Poker is documented in published rules and active table play traditions.
Short deck of 32 (4 players), 36 (5) or 40 (6) cards from a standard 52-card pack; lowest rank is 11 minus number of players.
Standard deck (short pack), chips for betting; ante amount and min/max limits agreed before play.
All players ante (invito). Optionally the first player may open blind (buio) before the deal; then dealer gives 5 cards each, one at a time clockwise starting to dealer's left.
